body.condition: For every \(v\in I\), every \(u\in\operatorname{pa}_0(v)\), and every \(A\) satisfying \(\operatorname{pa}_0(v)\setminus\{u\}\subseteq A\subseteq\operatorname{nd}_0(v)\setminus\{u,v\}\), there is an interior \(x_A\) of positive density such that the section \(x_u\mapsto f_v(x_{\operatorname{pa}_0(v)\setminus\{u\}},x_u)\), the conditional law \(\mathcal L(V_u\mid V_A=x_A)\), and \(\mathcal L(N_v)\) satisfy Peters et al.'s Condition 19 by failing their differential equation (7) on some open part of its domain.

novel.justification: This is the compact-section analogue of Peters et al.'s Condition 19 configuration requirement. It is directly checkable for smooth compact mechanisms and bump innovations by evaluating their differential equation on an interior section; failure on an open section is stable under small three-times continuously differentiable perturbations and includes the quadratic and cosine mechanisms used here.
